summary.text: Nate Stout is a business consultant and the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Heath VanNatter.
He lists public education funding and government transparency among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Nate Stout graduated from Tipton High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana University in 2005.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a father of two teenagers and a small business owner who spent more than 20 years growing sales for brands in the golf, fishing and hospitality industries.
Stout advanced from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
He said he describes himself as a fiscal conservative and wants to end subsidized private education and reinvest those dollars in public schools, including higher teacher pay.
He also said he wants to improve transparency in business dealings and support small businesses.
